meta.name: good-strategy-bad-strategy
meta.description: Formulate and audit real strategy using Richard Rumelt's "Good Strategy Bad Strategy": an honest diagnosis, a guiding policy, and coherent action instead of goals, vision, and wishful thinking. Use when the user mentions "good strategy bad strategy", "strategy kernel", "diagnosis guiding policy coherent action", "our strategy is just goals", "strategic planning", "mission vs strategy", "annual plan", or "is this actually a strategy". Also trigger when auditing a strategy doc or pitch deck for fluff, turning a goal list into real strategy, formulating strategy for a product or company, or finding leverage and proximate objectives. Covers the kernel of strategy, bad-strategy detection, and sources of power. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome. For uncontested markets, see blue-ocean-strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用战略三要素诊断和制定真实策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要区分好战略与坏战略，把目标清单变成真正的策略。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and formulate real strategy using the kernel of good strategy.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to distinguish good strategy from bad and turn goal lists into real strategy.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你用“诊断-指导政策-连贯行动”框架制定或审计策略，识别空话、目标冒充策略等坏策略，并给出评分和改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“好策略坏策略”、“策略内核”、“诊断指导政策连贯行动”等关键词，或要求审计策略文档、将目标列表转化为真实策略时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这份战略文档，找出坏策略的迹象。
say.note: Claude 会按四个坏策略特征逐项检查并评分。

say.text: 我们团队的目标是增长20%，请帮我制定一个真正的策略。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成诊断、指导政策和连贯行动。

say.text: 这个策略有杠杆点吗？帮我分析一下。
say.note: Claude 会从杠杆、近端目标等来源评估策略的力量。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you formulate or audit strategy using the 'diagnosis-guiding policy-coherent action' kernel, detect bad strategy hallmarks, and score strategies with improvement suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'good strategy bad strategy', 'strategy kernel', 'diagnosis guiding policy coherent action', or ask to audit a strategy doc, turn goals into strategy, etc.

say_en.text: Audit this strategy document for bad strategy signs.
say_en.note: Claude checks against four hallmarks and scores it.

say_en.text: Our goal is 20% growth. Help me build a real strategy.
say_en.note: Claude guides through diagnosis, policy, and actions.

say_en.text: Does this strategy have leverage? Analyze it.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates sources of power like leverage and proximate objectives.
